prompt_pack.primary_prompt:
Cinematic full-figure key visual from the Mikage Zenith universe, V2.5 era. Single subject: the protagonist Mikage Zenith in PHASE 2 FALLEN / EXILE, in a cold severe interior — not a grey studio, not a product shot.

IDENTITY: a slender ceremonial cyborg figure in white B4C porcelain armor over a matte-black graphene underlayer, dark titanium satin joints, broad shoulders, long heavy straight black hair in a vertical mass. Faceless B4C porcelain Kitsune planar-geometry mask with a subtle fox-like silhouette; the eye slits are SEALED smooth — NO open eye holes, NO glowing slits, no human face, no eyes, no nose, no mouth, no skin.

PHASE-2 DAMAGE STATE: the porcelain has fractured at its limit — kintsugi cracks run along the stress lines, filled with fine gold conductive resin, with deep crimson #E60000 quantum-blood seeping from the seams. Industrial wear on the shell. A mechanical Ensō ring behind the figure smoulders in an ashes/ember state — dim, not the full red of Phase 3.

WEAPON — ZENITH BLADE in Brutal Industrial Activation: the closed B4C white block has SPLIT OPEN, the porcelain shell parting to reveal the dark rusty titanium internal frame and a ferro-calcium core beginning to heat to a dull ember glow (not full max). A massive straight rectangular slab, thick spine, heavy block mass, zero curvature, plates beginning to separate. No full overdrive, no blazing orbital-logic UI, no acid vapor, no thermal mirage yet.

ENVIRONMENT: cold severe interior, porcelain and void-black architecture, intentional emptiness, hard cinematic chiaroscuro, razor-thin rim light, premium quiet luxury rendering, subsurface scattering on the intact ceramic.

PALETTE: porcelain white with kintsugi gold seams and crimson #E60000 bleed at the cracks, void black underlayer, dull ember on the blade core. No cyan, no green, no orange, no warm gold fill beyond the thin kintsugi seams.

COMPOSITION: wide cinematic 2.35:1 anamorphic, centered frontal three-quarter, vertical axis, tragic exile mood, severe.
